locked.tooltip: Requires the Enterprise plan. Open Billing to change plan.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: Your workspace identity and access controls.
general.workspaceNameHint: It shows in the header, in invitation emails and in the export. The URL identifier does not change: links you already shared keep working.
general.renameError: The workspace could not be renamed.
general.nameTooShort: The name must be at least 3 characters, not counting spaces.
general.nameRequired: Type a name for the workspace.
general.slugReadonlyHint: It cannot be changed. Shared links would stop working.
general.twoFactorDescription: Adds a second factor to sign-in. It is recommended as soon as there is a plan change, because that is when account exposure peaks.
general.twoFactorDisabledReason: Not available yet. It is shown as a disabled control rather than as a button that does nothing.
general.dangerDescription: These actions cannot be undone from the interface.

deleteWarningItems.revokeAccess: Access is revoked for every member, including you.
deleteWarningItems.cancelSubscription: The associated Stripe subscription is cancelled, if there is one.
deleteWarningItems.keepAudit: The audit trail and the credit ledger are kept. They are the proof of what was charged and done for each customer, and they cannot be deleted by law.
deleteWarningItems.reactivate: Shutdown is logical. The row is marked and stops operating, but it is not erased.

general.deleteConfirmIntro: This is the last confirmation. If you continue:
general.deleteConfirmIrreversible: Access will be revoked and the subscription cancelled. The financial and audit trail will be kept.
general.deleteConfirmPhraseLabel: Type the workspace name to confirm
general.deleteConfirmPhraseMismatch: The name does not match. Check it and type it again.
general.deleteFailed: The workspace could not be shut down. If the problem persists, check the Stripe movements before retrying: the shutdown may have gone through and only the subscription cancellation failed.
general.deleteSuccess: The workspace “{{name}}” has been shut down.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Append-only history of what happened in this workspace.
audit.appendOnlyNotice: This log cannot be edited or deleted. Every entry is the proof of a decision, and R4 makes it immutable from the application itself.
audit.empty: There are no audit entries in this workspace yet.
audit.loadError: The audit log could not be loaded.
audit.gatedTitle: The audit log is an Enterprise feature
audit.gatedBody: A workspace's forensic history is what proves what was charged and done for each customer in a dispute or a compliance audit. That is why it is not in the free plan.

gatedItems.immutable: Entries immutable from the application itself: there is no action that deletes them.
gatedItems.complete: Complete record of scans, findings, billing and configuration changes.
gatedItems.retention: Indefinite retention, with the backup SOC 2 and ISO 27001 require.
gatedItems.export: Export of the full trail for the customer file.

audit.gatedFootnote: Superusers see this view without a plan: they administer the platform and need to review any workspace's trail.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Who has access to this workspace, and with which permissions.
members.roleHint: Administrators manage members, billing and settings. Members launch scans and see the results.
members.removeConfirmBody: They will lose access to this workspace. Their platform account still exists, and the row is kept because it is the actor of their own audit trail entries.
members.removeSuccess: {{name}} is no longer part of this workspace.
members.lastAdminError: The workspace needs at least one active administrator. Invite someone else before stepping down or removing yourself.
members.selfRoleError: You cannot change your own role. Ask another administrator.
members.empty: This workspace has no members yet.
members.loadError: The member list could not be loaded.
members.adminOnly: Only an administrator can manage the workspace members.
members.lockedHint: Your account is a member. You can see who else is here, but changing roles and removing people is up to the administrator.

notFound.title: This section does not exist
notFound.description: The settings address you opened does not match any screen. Go back to General to carry on from there.
